_note: The order menu. tokens = pilot estimate (see docs/PRICING.md); every item is made by a maker agent, checked by a fresh blind tester for its subject and by Wilco's test-wise bots, and logged by the reporter.

items.label: Worksheet with answer key
items.detail: Practice that gets harder (3 levels), a student copy and a teacher copy with the key.

items.label: Guided notes
items.detail: Fill-in notes that follow your source, with a teacher copy.

items.label: Quiz with A/B versions
items.detail: 8–12 questions, two versions with the same skills, keys for both.

items.label: Unit test with A/B versions
items.detail: 20–30 questions with about 40% harder questions, two versions, keys and a skills map.

items.label: Study guide / review sheet
items.detail: One or two pages of what to know, with practice and a key.

items.label: Lesson slides
items.detail: A slide deck that follows your source, with speaker notes.

items.label: Review game
items.detail: A printable or projector review game (question cards or a board) with answers.

items.label: Rubric
items.detail: A rubric for a task or project, with student-friendly wording.

items.label: Project or lab packet
items.detail: Instructions, steps, a checklist and a rubric for a longer project or lab.

items.label: Whole unit pack
items.detail: Notes, a worksheet per lesson, a quiz, a review and a unit test with A/B versions.

items.label: Bell ringers
items.detail: A set of 10 short warm-ups (one a day), each with a key, that review what came before and preview what's next.

items.label: Homework
items.detail: A short practice set for home (shorter than a worksheet), with a key and a teacher copy.

items.label: Make versions of my test
items.detail: Drop in a test you already have: we make A/B versions (or A/B/C) that test the same skills at the same level, with keys, and our checkers look over your original too and tell you anything they find.

items.label: Full unit from standards
items.detail: From a page of standards: a unit plan, guided notes and homework for each lesson (up to 4 lessons), bell ringers, two quizzes, a project with its rubric, a review and a unit test with A/B versions.

items.label: Quiz-show review game
items.detail: A projector game with categories and point values (like the TV quiz shows), with answers in the presenter notes and a printable score sheet.

items.label: Crossword puzzle
items.detail: A crossword built from your vocabulary or key ideas, with clues written for your grade and a key.

items.label: Word search
items.detail: A word search from your vocabulary list, with a key.

items.label: Logic puzzles
items.detail: Grid logic puzzles and other reasoning puzzles built on your topic, each checked to have exactly one solution.

items.label: Review app
items.detail: A small app students open on any device (flashcards, memorize-by-steps, practice quizzes that come back to what they miss). Works offline, no accounts.

items.label: Interactive worksheet
items.detail: A worksheet students fill in on a device: it checks answers as they go, gives hints after two misses, saves on the device, and comes with a teacher solutions page.

extras.label: Sell-it-yourself guide (TPT)
extras.detail: How to list your pack on Teachers Pay Teachers, with the AI note to include.

extras.label: Set up my agents with my examples
extras.detail: Your agents read the examples you upload and follow your layout, wording and level. First time only.
